title: Expensive Queries Stress Test (120+ panels)
description: Synthetic load fixture for custom-dashboard performance work. Every non-text panel carries a query that is expensive per step: long-window histogram quantiles, subqueries, per-pod cardinality, regex matchers, 7d increases, topk over wide inputs, joins, and max-row entity tables. Each panel's description says why. Open on Last 1 hour first; Last 7 days is the worst case. The account id is a placeholder: the importer will ask you to map it to a kubernetes account.

panels.title: 7 · Vector matching joins
panels.content: group_left joins multiply the left-hand series by a lookup on kube_pod_info / kube_pod_labels.

panels.title: cpu by pod with node

targets.expr: sum by (pod, node)(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{__CLUSTER__ container!=""}[5m]) * on (pod) group_left(node) max by (pod, node)(kube_pod_info{__CLUSTER__}))

panels.description: Join: both sides materialised per step, matched on pod or node. Right side deduplicated with max by (...) so group_left has one match per key.

panels.title: memory by pod with owner

targets.expr: sum by (pod, owner_name)(container_memory_working_set_bytes{__CLUSTER__ container!=""} * on (pod) group_left(owner_name) max by (pod, owner_name)(kube_pod_owner{__CLUSTER__}))

panels.description: Join: both sides materialised per step, matched on pod or node. Right side deduplicated with max by (...) so group_left has one match per key.

panels.title: cpu usage vs requests by pod

targets.expr: sum by (pod)(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{__CLUSTER__ container!=""}[5m])) / on (pod) sum by (pod)(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{__CLUSTER__ resource="cpu"})

panels.description: Join: both sides materialised per step, matched on pod or node. Right side deduplicated with max by (...) so group_left has one match per key.

panels.title: memory usage vs limits by pod

targets.expr: sum by (pod)(container_memory_working_set_bytes{__CLUSTER__ container!=""}) / on (pod) sum by (pod)(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{__CLUSTER__ resource="memory"})

panels.description: Join: both sides materialised per step, matched on pod or node. Right side deduplicated with max by (...) so group_left has one match per key.

panels.title: restarts with pod labels

targets.expr: sum by (pod, label_app)(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{__CLUSTER__} * on (pod) group_left(label_app) max by (pod, label_app)(kube_pod_labels{__CLUSTER__}))

panels.description: Join: both sides materialised per step, matched on pod or node. Right side deduplicated with max by (...) so group_left has one match per key.

panels.title: runner pods with node & phase

targets.expr: sum by (pod, node, phase)(kube_pod_status_phase{__CLUSTER__ namespace=~"arc-system.*"} * on (pod) group_left(node) max by (pod, node)(kube_pod_info{__CLUSTER__}))

panels.description: Join: both sides materialised per step, matched on pod or node. Right side deduplicated with max by (...) so group_left has one match per key.

panels.title: network rx by pod with node

targets.expr: sum by (pod, node)(rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{__CLUSTER__}[5m]) * on (pod) group_left(node) max by (pod, node)(kube_pod_info{__CLUSTER__}))

panels.description: Join: both sides materialised per step, matched on pod or node. Right side deduplicated with max by (...) so group_left has one match per key.

panels.title: throttling vs limits by pod

targets.expr: sum by (pod)(rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total{__CLUSTER__}[5m])) / on (pod) sum by (pod)(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{__CLUSTER__ resource="cpu"})

panels.description: Join: both sides materialised per step, matched on pod or node. Right side deduplicated with max by (...) so group_left has one match per key.

panels.title: pods per node with node labels

targets.expr: count by (node, label_kubernetes_io_arch)(kube_pod_info{__CLUSTER__} * on (node) group_left(label_kubernetes_io_arch) max by (node, label_kubernetes_io_arch)(kube_node_labels{__CLUSTER__}))

panels.description: Join: both sides materialised per step, matched on pod or node. Right side deduplicated with max by (...) so group_left has one match per key.

panels.title: cpu by pod on spot nodes

targets.expr: sum by (pod)(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{__CLUSTER__ container!=""}[5m]) * on (pod) group_left(node) max by (pod, node)(kube_pod_info{__CLUSTER__}) * on (node) group_left() max by (node)(kube_node_labels{__CLUSTER__ label_cloud_google_com_gke_spot="true"}))

panels.description: Join: both sides materialised per step, matched on pod or node. Right side deduplicated with max by (...) so group_left has one match per key.
